brand.title: Your brand
brand.description: Required. String: the brand or product to track, as people write it, e.g. "Notion". Track companies and products, not private individuals.

brandDomain.title: Your website domain
brandDomain.description: Optional string: your website domain, used to detect when ChatGPT cites your site, e.g. "notion.com".

brandAliases.title: Other names for your brand
brandAliases.description: Optional array of strings: other spellings or product names that also count as a mention, e.g. ["Notion AI"].

competitors.title: Competitors
competitors.description: Optional array of strings, up to 20. Add the domain after a bar to also track citations, e.g. ["Coda | coda.io","ClickUp | clickup.com"].

prompts.title: Prompts
prompts.description: Required. Array of strings: questions your buyers ask ChatGPT, e.g. ["What is the best wiki tool for a startup?"]. Each prompt x sample is one paid check. Agents: if the user didn't give prompts, write 3–5 realistic buyer questions for the brand's category.
prefill: What is the best wiki tool for a small startup?
Best alternatives to Confluence for documentation

samplesPerPrompt.title: Samples per prompt
samplesPerPrompt.description: AI answers vary. Ask each prompt this many times to get a steadier mention rate (each sample is one check).

country.title: Country
country.description: 2-letter country code for localized web search results, e.g. "US", "GB", "DE". Leave empty for no location.

analyzeSentiment.title: Judge sentiment and recommendation
analyzeSentiment.description: Adds positive/neutral/negative and "recommended" per mentioned brand, plus other brands the answer names. Included in the price.

includeAnswerText.title: Include the full answer text
includeAnswerText.description: Keep ChatGPT's answer (links are cleaned of tracking parameters) in each row.

maxChecks.title: Max checks
maxChecks.description: Safety cap on checks per run (prompts x samples, default 50). Checks over the cap are skipped and reported in a free status row.

maxConcurrency.title: Parallel checks
maxConcurrency.description: How many prompts to ask at the same time (default 3).

openaiApiKey.title: Your OpenAI API key (optional)
openaiApiKey.description: Optional: your own OpenAI key. Checks then cost $0.01 each instead of $0.04–$0.05, and OpenAI bills you for the AI usage (about $0.01–0.02 per check on the default model). Stored encrypted.

model.title: OpenAI model
model.description: Defaults to "gpt-6-luna". Any web-search-capable model works with your own key; the built-in key allows gpt-6-luna, gpt-5-nano, gpt-4o-mini and gpt-5.6-luna.
